name: Create EMR JobFlow

fields.description: The IAM role that was specified when the JobFlow was created. The EC2 instances of the JobFlow assume this role

fields.name: ServiceRole
fields.title: Service Role
fields.description: The IAM role that is assumed by the Amazon EMR service to access Amazon Web Services resources on your behalf

fields.name: retry_exponential_backoff
